responsibility: Provides match-lowering utilities for CFG shaping and guard soundness, including false-edge emission, collection of fake borrows required to keep matched places stable across guards, traversal of candidate and pattern structures to determine borrow roots and strengths, and helper conversion of ref-pattern mutability to MIR borrow kinds.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `thir/util.rs`, which provides THIR-side type-annotation lookup helpers, this `util.rs` is specific to MIR match lowering and supplies CFG/borrow utilities such as false edges, fake-borrow collection for guards, and ref-pattern borrow-kind conversion.
